title: Txn-Token header present on WPT request with wrong tth hash
wire_note: The 401 body carries no reason (the cause, proof-invalid, is in the peer journal); the WWW-Authenticate: WPT challenge is checked on the wire.

title: Expired Txn-Token rejected by File Tool
Txn-Token signed with untrusted rogue key rejected by File Tool
Txn-Token with wrong typ=jwt rejected by File Tool
Txn-Token missing required req_wl claim rejected by File Tool
Request with duplicate Txn-Token headers rejected by File Tool
Txn-Token with scope=profile:view rejected on files:read route
AS-B rejects a non-grant JWT (typ at+jwt) presented as a cross-domain grant (RFC 7523 s3.1: 400 invalid_grant)
wire_note: The other half of D5, the driver's outbound guard refusing to send a Domain A Txn-Token to Domain B, happens before any packet is sent, so it is not wire evidence.

title: TTS-A issues a narrowed replacement Txn-Token; a widening request and a replacement from an expired token are refused (forged widened, txn-, sub- and aud-mutated replacements are rejected by the driver, not on the wire)
wire_note: On the wire TTS-A issues the original and the narrowed token (200) and refuses the widening request (invalid_scope) and the replacement from an expired token (invalid_grant). The rejection of forged widened, txn-, sub- and aud-mutated replacements is checked by the driver, so it is not wire evidence.

title: Cross-domain grant with the wrong audience: AS-A refuses an unknown target, AS-B refuses a grant minted for another audience
TTS-A request without WIT and signature is refused (the TTS authenticates the requesting workload)
TTS-B request with a Txn-Token but no WIT proof is refused (a Txn-Token does not authenticate a workload)
Research's WIT presented with the Coordinator's key proof is refused by the File Tool
/admin/revoke refuses a caller without proof (401) and a workload that is not an operator (403); the revocation set is unchanged
A requester named in the Txn-Token request body is ignored: req_wl is the verified WIT subject
